source_notes: DCA describes this report as selected data entered by municipalities in the Affordable Housing Monitoring System.
The report states it is not a comprehensive listing of all affordable housing units/developments in New Jersey.
The report states the data are presented as-is and DCA makes no certifications as to accuracy.
HUD-subsidized units, LMI cost burden and an inferred affordable-units pipeline are intentionally excluded.

njplus.nj-dca-affordable-housing.low_inc.label: Low-income affordable units
njplus.nj-dca-affordable-housing.low_inc.description: Legacy marker ID retained for compatibility. The DCA source column is Low Income affordable units (30%–50% of area median income), not a household count.
njplus.nj-dca-affordable-housing.low_inc.source_field: Low Income (Affordable between 30% and 50% of Area Median Income)
njplus.nj-dca-affordable-housing.low_inc.semantic_note: Legacy field name says households; source semantics are affordable-unit count.
